name: senscheck-governance-core
description: Review and implement fail-closed boundaries around consequential AI-agent actions.

interface.shortDescription: Review and implement fail-closed boundaries around consequential agent actions.
interface.longDescription: Agents fail. Fail closed. Review a repository for fail-open paths, then wrap consequential tools and functions with SensCheck Governance Core: canonical effects, deterministic policy, authority checks, human approval and receipts. Works entirely locally; no account, no network calls.
defaultPrompt: Use SensCheck Governance to review this repository for fail-open agent actions.
Use SensCheck Governance to protect this tool with a fail-closed boundary.
